SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Not a filing. Written for tests/test_buyback_disclosure.py.

Item 8.01 Other Events

On June 26, 2026, the Board of Directors of Synthetic Testco plc authorized an
increase of $5.0 billion in the company's existing open-market share repurchase
program. Following this authorization, the aggregate amount authorized under the
program since its inception is $59.1 billion, and approximately $8.2 billion
remains available for repurchases. The program has no expiration date and the
company is not obligated to acquire any particular amount of ordinary shares.
